# Episode 3 audio sources

These local MP3s use CC0 1.0 sources. They are a mix of natural recordings and realistic foley; they must not be described collectively as unmodified field recordings. No existing horse or episode recordings were changed. The two horse files supplied by the player remain the source for riding and jumping.

License: [Creative Commons Zero 1.0](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/). Attribution is included for provenance even though CC0 does not require it. Source pages were checked on 2026-11-13.

| Shipped file | Source and author | Recording/foley and preparation |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `cave-ambient.mp3` | [Dripping water loop](https://opengameart.org/content/dripping-water-loop), Independent.nu, submitted by qubodup; [Loopable Dungeon Ambience](https://opengameart.org/content/loopable-dungeon-ambience), JaggedStone | Water-drip ambience with a very quiet, low-passed wind layer. 24-second edit, two-second head/tail crossfade, gentle loudness normalization. The donor dungeon loop is labelled an ambient sound effect by its author, not an unprocessed cave recording. No music or new oscillator tones were added. |
| `cave-rock.mp3` | [Moving Boulder](https://opengameart.org/content/moving-boulder), themightyglider; donor recordings credited there: [IDLauncher](https://freesound.org/people/IDLauncher/sounds/513236/) and [magnuswaker](https://freesound.org/people/magnuswaker/sounds/522099/) | Stone scrape and a quieter stone impact, trimmed and given a short room echo. |
| `cave-steam.mp3` | [Steam release sounds](https://opengameart.org/content/steam-release-sounds), bart | Steam-hiss foley, two overlapping edited hisses, gentle filtering and fades. This is a steam sound effect, not a claim of recording an actual volcanic fumarole. |
| `cave-bats.mp3` | [Bat Screeches](https://opengameart.org/content/bat-screeches), AntumDeluge, from [polymorpheva's recording](https://freesound.org/s/104205/); [Large Wings Flap](https://opengameart.org/content/large-wings-flap), AntumDeluge, based on [dave.des's chop foley](https://freesound.org/s/127197/) | Actual recorded bat calls with the author's background-noise cleanup, mixed softly under quicker wing foley. The flaps are foley rather than a recording of real bat wings. Short cave echo and fades. |
| `cave-lizards.mp3` | [Various Sound Effects](https://opengameart.org/content/various-sound-effects-0), Julie Damsgaard / Spring Spring / Spring Enterprises (`rustling_of_the_weeds.wav`); [Tiny Croc Chirp](https://freesound.org/people/iwanPlays/sounds/511430/), iwanPlays | Natural rustle/scurry foley with quiet calls of a small crocodile. The original crocodile uploader states that permission was obtained to release the sound as CC0. This mix represents fantasy cave lizards; it is not a field recording of those species. |
| `cave-turtle.mp3` | [Grunting Turtle 02](https://sfxmint.com/sounds/turtle-02), SFXMint | **Pre-existing AI-generated naturalistic foley**, explicitly labelled AI-generated by its CC0 source. Soft low animal-like breath/grunt, filtered slightly and given a short room echo. Not presented as a real tortoise field recording. Source prompt: “A large tortoise gives a long groaning grunt”. |
| `cave-crystal.mp3` | [2022-01-14-crystal-bell-08.flac](https://freesound.org/people/arseniiv/sounds/614832/), arseniiv | Recorded crystal-glass bell. Short gentle chink with a natural resonant decay; trimmed and faded, no generated melody or oscillator. |

All seven files are 44.1 kHz mono MP3 at 96 kbit/s. Processing uses edits, level control, filters, mixing and short echoes rather than synthesized replacement noises. The cave loop is intentionally quiet and spacious. All exported peaks remain below -4 dBFS; the game mixer applies its independent effect/music volumes and limiter.
